Name: Oren
Summary: Son of Jerahmeel, named among the sons of Jerahmeel.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:25: Son of Jerahmeel, named among the sons of Jerahmeel.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Oren stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
